title: 1876 켄터키 고기비

images.prompt: 1876 rural Kentucky, late morning: close view of two weathered hands of a faceless farmer silhouette holding a small piece of dark red raw meat above a dented tin plate on a wooden porch rail, a perfectly clear cloudless pale sky in the upper part, nobody eating, no blood.
A 1870s Kentucky farmhouse with a wooden porch and split-rail fence among rolling fields, a perfectly clear cloudless pale sky, late morning, very still.

A wooden farmhouse porch in 1876 Kentucky: an iron soap kettle steaming over a small fire, a woman seen from behind at a distance as a faceless silhouette looking up, small dark flakes drifting down through bright still air like snow under a clear cloudless sky.

High angle view of one small rectangular patch of grass bounded by a split-rail fence on a farm, small dark scattered pieces lying only inside the patch, the rest of the field clean and green, clear daylight, no blood.

A 19th-century brass microscope on a dark wooden desk at night, seven small glass specimen dishes in a row, a single amber oil lamp, paper labels blurred and unreadable, an old glass jar in the background.
